title: Yuanjing Integrated Urban Management Platform
summary: China Unicom describes AI dispatch, monitoring, and event management. Improvements in city services remain unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Unicom is developing AI dispatch, monitoring, and event management for cities. Improvements in city services remain unmeasured.
purpose: Help municipalities detect issues, dispatch resources, and respond to residents.

ratings.reason: Municipal operators are intended to allocate resources and handle requests more efficiently.
Residents are intended to receive more responsive basic services.
More inclusive and resource-efficient cities are intended outcomes, with no measured change supplied.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: Yuanjing Integrated Urban Management Platform

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: The conditions needed to reproduce the benefit are unspecified.

headline: Yuanjing proposes AI-assisted urban management
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
